about: Kajaria Ceramics Limited manufactures, sells, and distributes ceramic and vitrified wall and floor tiles under the Kajaria, GresBond, and Eternity brands in India and internationally. The company operates through Tiles and Others segments. It offers ceramic wall and floor tiles, polished vitrified tiles, glazed vitrified tiles, grestough floor tiles, tile adhesives, and tile cleaners.
